name: Marlee Greer
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I'm Marlee (she/they), and I offer online therapy across Australia for women, trans, and non-binary adults who are queer or neurodivergent, and trying to make sense of burnout, identity, and relationships. Most of the people I work with arrive knowing something feels off, but without the words, or the room, to work out what. I'm a queer, AuDHD therapist, and I've been the one looking for a therapist myself, so I know how much finding the right fit matters.
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Ashley Karstunen
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: If you're carrying the weight of trauma, facing anxiety or grief, seeking LGBTQ+ affirming support, or exploring purpose and belonging, you're not alone. I'm Ashley Karstunen, a Registered Clinical Counsellor, Depth therapist, and Trauma-Informed EFT Practitioner specializing in trauma recovery, anxiety treatment, and somatic therapy approaches that honor your whole self. Clinical Specialisations: • Trauma Therapy using Process-Oriented Psychotherapy and somatic approaches • Trauma-Informed EFT (Emotional Freedom Techniques) for rapid emotional regulation • Anxiety and Depression treatment through nervous system regulation • LGBTQ+ Affirming Therapy that celebrates authentic identity • Grief and Loss counselling with compassion and mindfulness integration. Therapeutic Approach: Since 2017, I've supported clients through PTSD recovery, life transitions, identity exploration, and feeling stuck or unfulfilled. My practice integrates Trauma-Informed EFT, Process-Oriented Psychology, mindfulness practices, and somatic interventions to create personalized treatment that addresses root causes rather than just symptoms.
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Awombda Codd
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Awombda is a Gestalt relational psychotherapist who is passionate about change, choice and allowing space to grow. She has worked in the community sector for over 18 years with expertise in mental health, homelessness and drug and alcohol. Awombda has extensive experience working with anxiety and depression, grief and loss, trauma, LGBTIQ community and substance use issues.
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery
